verdict: changes_requested: 1 major, 1 minor, 0 blocker, 0 nit over 22 keys. The gender half of the fix is right (agents is masculine) and the fit claim is confirmed in the rendered DOM; the shared key still renders a PLURAL adjective in the per-agent slots, and the sr-only legend still names 'définitions' (feminine) while its options now agree with 'agents'.

findings.problem: The same key is also the per-item source word: sourceLabel() (detail-parts.tsx:258-266) feeds SourceChip on every roster row (agents-page.tsx:1455) and AgentMeta on one agent's detail line (agent-detail.tsx:171). In those slots the referent is ONE agent, so a plural adjective is an agreement error. The rendered frame shows 'Intégrés' beside the single rows architect / coder / copy-reviewer, 'Créés' on aa-custom and 'Installés' on Aida. Masculine is correct (the visible noun is 'agent', as in the shipped 'Agent intégré' and 'Aucun agent créé'), but the NUMBER is not.
findings.evidence: Frame fr-fit-agents-roster.png (sha256 60e39a85...) at frames/fr-fit-agents-roster.png; call sites cited above; shipped fr uses per-item singular ('Agent intégré', 'Aucun agent créé') and group plural ('les agents intégrés', ui.library.origin.created 'Créés' as a group label).
findings.pre_existing: The round-2 bytes were feminine plural ('Intégrées'), equally number-wrong in the per-agent slots; the delta fixed gender and exposed the number problem more plainly.
findings.suggested: Exact fix for this catalogue-only PR: make the shared word singular and the All option invariable — ui.agents.pages.scope.all = 'Tout', ui.agents.pages.scope.builtin = 'Intégré', ui.agents.pages.scope.custom = 'Créé', ui.agents.pages.scope.installed = 'Installé'. The filter row then reads Tout | Créé | Installé | Intégré as class labels (idiomatic French filter register), the row chip and the meta line read 'Intégré' etc., and the empty states already agree ('Aucun agent créé / installé / intégré.'). The three new labels are one character shorter than the measured ones, so the measured 25.17 px slack cannot shrink; re-measure in the render before shipping. If the team prefers to keep plural filter labels, the correct alternative needs an en catalogue plus code change: add ui.agents.pages.source.builtin|installed|custom (en 'Built-in | Installed | Custom') and point sourceLabel() at them, keeping scope.* plural — out of this delta's scope. 'Tous' is not ungrammatical as a plural pronoun, but 'Tout' avoids mixing number inside one row.
